# Md. Zahid Hasan — AI & Cybersecurity Engineer (Full Technical Profile)

## Overview
Md. Zahid Hasan is an AI Engineer and Cybersecurity Specialist at BrainSpark Digital (https://brainsparkd.com/) based in Bangladesh. With a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from Uttara University, he specializes in engineering production Large Language Model (LLM) agents, RAG knowledge retrieval systems, computer vision pipelines, and conducting offensive and defensive cybersecurity audits.

## Featured Engineering Projects
- SparkFrame: AI visual storytelling platform using Gemini Nano vision anchoring. (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/sparkframe)
- PromptXpert: Automated prompt-engineering toolkit built on DSPy and Bayesian optimization. (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/promptxpert)
- MASA: Multi-Modal Adaptive Study Agent with RAG and knowledge graphs. (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/masa)
- SparkBot: Production customer support AI chatbot deployed at BrainSpark Digital. (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/sparkbot)
- Email Automation Agent: Autonomous multi-agent framework for inbox classification and draft generation. (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/email-automation-agent)
- GCC Daily Bazar: Live hyper-local online supermarket with cash on delivery and real-time tracking (https://gccdailybazar.shop/). (https://z4hid.github.io/projects/gcc-daily-bazar)

## Cybersecurity Writeups & Technical Audits
- Offensive Security: Active Directory exploitation, Kerberoasting, ACL abuse, and Domain Controller compromise. (https://z4hid.github.io/writeups/offensive/active-directory-kerberoasting-privesc)
- Defensive Security: Volatile memory forensics, Volatility 3, process hollowing detection, and Cobalt Strike Beacon configuration decoding. (https://z4hid.github.io/writeups/defensive/memory-forensics-volatility-malware-analysis)
